ns0:svg.ns0:text: Repeated user symbols represent the same roles. All access remains subject to permissions.
Guardians access linked tenants only and acknowledge overnight leave only. Geofencing events come from the tenant's smartphone.
Contracts, guardian links, confidential-report review, deposit finalization and analytics remain owner-controlled.
Uploaded receipts, images and documents are linked to their records. Flagged curfew events require staff review.
